title: Canadian Chicken Burger
description: A classic Canadian-inspired chicken burger recipe featuring a juicy chicken patty, crispy bacon, and melted cheddar cheese.

ingredients.name: burger
ingredients.notes: patty or substitute with 4 chicken breasts

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Season the chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and your favorite herbs.
3. Grill the chicken breasts for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, cook the bacon slices in a skillet over medium heat until crispy.
5. Assemble the burgers by spreading a layer of mayonnaise on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked chicken patty, a slice of cheese, a few strips of bacon, and finally the top bun.
6. Serve the burgers on a bed of lettuce, with your favorite toppings and condiments.
